heading: Masevhisi anogona kushandiswa nesaiti iyi
withdrawn: Sarudzo dzese dzabviswa. Sevhisi imwe neimwe ichabvunza zvakare.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Inoverenga kushanya nemapeji akaverengwa. Google inogamuchira kero yako yeIP uye inogona kuisa makuki.
serviceSends_youtube: Inotamba mavhidhiyo kubva paYouTube. Google inogamuchira kero yako yeIP uye inogona kuisa makuki.
serviceSends_vimeo: Inotamba mavhidhiyo kubva paVimeo. Vimeo inogamuchira kero yako yeIP; saiti iyi inoikumbira kuti isakuteedzere.
serviceSends_google_maps: Inoratidza mamepu kubva paGoogle Maps. Google inogamuchira kero yako yeIP uye inogona kuisa makuki.
serviceSends_speech: Kana browser yako isingakwanise kunzwisisa kutaura pamudziyo wako, izwi rako rinoenda kubasa rayo rekutaura (Google, Apple kana Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Inoratidza makadhi edura rekodhi nezvimwe zvirimo kubva paGitHub. GitHub inogamuchira kero yako yeIP uye inogona kuisa makuki.
serviceSends_webstatus: Inoratidza mabheji eBaseline ekutsigirwa nemabrowser kubva pawebstatus.dev, purojekiti yeGoogle Chrome. Google inogamuchira kero yako yeIP.
serviceSends_aframe: Inotakura raibhurari yeA-Frame kubva paaframe.io kuratidza zviitiko zve3D. aframe.io inogamuchira kero yako yeIP.
serviceSends_embed: Inoratidza zvirimo kubva ku{host}. {host} inogamuchira kero yako yeIP uye inogona kuisa makuki.
